review.name: Review
review.description: Multi-judge adversarial review with session continuity and anchor-checked citations. For implementing and reviewing code changes.

design.name: Design
design.description: Adversarial design: propose, cross-critique, synthesize a vetted spec. For turning a fuzzy goal into a concrete plan.

improvement.name: Improvement
improvement.description: Self-improvement cycles: select targets, curate findings, synthesize cross-cutting seams, card to genesis. Read-only analysis; no auto-fix.

research.name: Research
research.description: Fan-out research: decompose a question, parallel explorers, synthesize findings. For answering questions that need multiple angles.

reasoning.name: Divergent Reasoning
reasoning.description: Multi-runtime design-to-PR: different weight families propose independently, judge picks, implement, review, ship.

ticket.name: Ticket Factory
ticket.description: Isolated worktree-based ticket implementation with gates and review.

ops.name: Operations
ops.description: Session management, log compaction, dormant sweeps, exec-notify, panel fixes, skill evolution, monitoring, and other operational workflows.

routing.name: Routing
routing.description: Task→seat routing: deterministic envelope selection (tier, borrowed seat, reviewer, gate policy) before gauntlet dispatch. Inference seam: cognitive-router (:3068) when up.
